Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Master's Degree in Language (min. 55% marks) with 7 years' experience as Assistant Director/Assistant Secretary/Administrative Officer/Assistant Registrar or equivalent in Level 10 and above; OR Master's in Business/Public Administration (min. 55%) with the same 7 years' experience. Must also have demonstrable experience organizing literary activities/programmes/seminars/conferences/festivals at institutional, regional, or national level, and an unblemished integrity record (no pending criminal/vigilance/disciplinary proceedings, court case involving moral turpitude/financial irregularity, or chargesheet/prosecution sanction as on the closing date).

Post-graduate degree in a language/literature recognized by the Akademi; good knowledge of English/Hindi and one or more regional Indian languages; 5 years' experience in copy-editing literary/scholarly manuscripts through production stages; basic computer knowledge.
Bachelor in Library Science; 5 years' experience in a library of standing; good computer knowledge for library applications.

Graduate/Master's with Hindi/English as main subject (or equivalent combinations, per notification) plus a translation diploma/certificate where applicable; 3 years' experience in literary translation (Hindi-English/English-Hindi) in Central/State Government including autonomous organizations.

Graduate/equivalent; Diploma in Book Publishing; 5 years' experience in a printing press/publishing house/government undertaking concerned with book publication; knowledge of printing and book-publication processes; ability to edit literary material; basic computer knowledge.

Graduate/equivalent from a recognized university; 5 years' experience in a literary, academic, or government organization, or a publishing house; ability to organize meetings/conferences and handle literary material; good computer knowledge.

Graduate/equivalent; Diploma in Printing OR 5 years' experience in a printing press/publishing house/government undertaking on book publication; knowledge of printing/publication processes; basic computer knowledge.
Graduate/equivalent with Hindi/English as a subject; ability to read proofs in English/Hindi; proficiency in English/Hindi; basic computer knowledge.
10+2 or equivalent; 80 w.p.m. shorthand speed with good typing speed in English/Hindi; good computer knowledge.
10+2; valid motor driving licence for two-wheelers/car with 3 years' experience; knowledge of motor mechanics.
10th or 10+2; valid driving licence for light and heavy vehicles; knowledge of minor automobile repairs; 3 years' motor-driving experience; polite behaviour.
10+2; net typing speed of 35 w.p.m. in English or 30 w.p.m. in Hindi; knowledge of computer applications.
10th/10+2 from a recognized board/institution, or ITI equivalent; multi-skilling ability (one employee performing tasks previously handled by different Level-1 employees); basic computer knowledge.

qualification.details: Each post also carries additional "Desirable" (preferred, not mandatory) qualifications specified in the official notification - such as research/doctoral degrees, knowledge of additional Indian languages, or general knowledge of Indian literature - which candidates should review in full before applying. All educational qualifications, age, and experience must be fulfilled as on the closing date of application.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format from the Akademi's website: https://sahitya-akademi.gov.in.
Fill the application giving full details, and attach a recent self-attested passport-size photograph along with self-attested copies of all required documents.
Submit a separate application form for each post applied for (applying more than once for the same post may lead to cancellation of candidature).
Superscribe the envelope "Application for the post of ________" (naming the specific post).
Send the application by Speed Post or Registered Post only, addressed to: The Secretary, Sahitya Akademi, Rabindra Bhavan, 35 Ferozeshah Road, New Delhi-110001.

Ensure the application reaches within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News (last date: 21 September 2026). Applications sent by email, or incomplete, unsigned, undocumented, or late applications, will be rejected.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted only in the prescribed format available on the Akademi's website; applications without this format, or without self-attested copies of educational documents, experience, and caste certificates, will be liable to rejection. Candidates are responsible for assessing their own eligibility for the post; furnishing false, tampered, or fabricated information, or suppressing material information, will lead to cancellation of candidature/appointment at any stage - even after appointment - without further notice. The number of posts advertised may vary, and the Akademi reserves the right to fill or not fill any advertised post(s). Candidates should apply early to avoid last-minute rush; the Akademi is not responsible for postal or courier delays. Any addendum or corrigendum will be posted only on the Akademi's website (https://sahitya-akademi.gov.in). Candidates called for written test/skill test/interview must attend at their own expense; no TA/DA will be paid. The Akademi reserves the right to fix additional shortlisting criteria if a large number of applications are received for any post. The selected incumbent is liable to be transferred to any office of the Akademi located in India. If any inadvertent mistake in the selection process is detected at any stage, even after issue of the appointment letter, the Akademi reserves the right to modify/cancel/withdraw any communication made to the candidate. The qualifications prescribed are as per Sahitya Akademi rules, pending approval of the Ministry.

faq.question: Q1. What is Sahitya Akademi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct-recruitment drive by Sahitya Akademi (National Academy of Letters), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Culture, to fill 30 posts across 13 designations, per Advertisement No. 50/2/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Sahitya Akademi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 30 posts across 13 designations, ranging from Deputy Secretary to Multi-Tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Sahitya Akademi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach within 30 days of the advertisement's publication in Employment News — the notified last date is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Sahitya Akademi posts?
faq.answer: It varies by post — from 10th/10+2 for Multi-Tasking Staff and Junior Clerk to a Master's degree with relevant experience for Deputy Secretary. See the Eligibility section for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Sahitya Akademi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years for all posts, with relaxation as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Sahitya Akademi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹1,000 (UR/OBC) or ₹500 (SC/ST/Women) for Level-10/11 posts; ₹800 (UR/OBC) or ₹500 (SC/ST/Women) for Level-1 to Level-6 posts; nil for EWS/PwD candidates. Fee is payable only by Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Sahitya Akademi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent offline, in the prescribed format from the Akademi's website, by Speed Post or Registered Post to the Secretary, Sahitya Akademi, New Delhi — online/email applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Sahitya Akademi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It varies by post: interview only for Deputy Secretary and Assistant Editor; a two-part written test (objective + descriptive) for other posts, followed by a qualifying skill test (stenography, typing, or driving) for some posts.
